title: Ensuring Reliability of Curated EHR-Derived Data: The Validation of Accuracy for LLM/ML-Extracted Information and Data (VALID) Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Stratifying variable-level performance metrics and automated verification checks by race/ethnicity, and replicating health equity research questions (e.g., evaluating whether LLM-generated data replicates known lower survival rates among Black patients compared to White patients).
Stratifying variable-level performance metrics and automated verification checks by age subgroups to identify differential model error rates across different age groups.
Stratifying variable-level performance metrics and automated verification checks by gender to detect extraction performance disparities between male and female patient cohorts.

Stratifying variable-level performance metrics and verification checks by clinical characteristics, such as specific treatments received, biomarker status, and disease stage, to ensure accuracy does not disproportionately degrade for certain medical profiles.
